shellCommands.command: git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx && echo ---MAIN--- && cat src/main.tsx && echo ---INDEX--- && cat index.html && echo ---VITE--- && cat vite.config.ts && echo ---TSCONFIG--- && cat tsconfig.json && echo ---RUN--- && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80 && echo ---GITIGNORE--- && cat .gitignore && ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -3

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo INSTALLED || echo NOT_INSTALLED; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal 2>/dev/null

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Dialog/Dialog.d.ts && cat Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls Dialog/DialogFooter Dialog/DialogBody; cat Dialog/index.d.ts; echo ---MODAL---; cat Modal/Modal.d.ts | head -60; echo ---BUTTON---; sed -n 1,80p Button/Button.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Dialog && cat DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts DialogBody/DialogBody.d.ts | head -60; grep -n "onClickButtonApply\|onClickButtonCancel\|textButton" DialogFooter/DialogFooter.js | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -n 15; echo "BUILD_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
